_notes: alternate: copy the primary block, change name and voice_id, and the alternate voice is used on even weeks (or odd, see alternate_weeks).
copy_tracks_to: e.g. "~/My Drive/tieng-viet-audio" to get the finished daily tracks on your phone. Per-sentence files stay local.
docx_link_base: absolute path of this folder on the Mac where you open the booklets; the audio links in the docx are built from it. Leave null for relative links.
model_id: eleven_v3, chosen in the blind test of 17 Sep 2026 (v3 beat flash 2.5). v3 takes no language_code and no speed; stability accepts 0.0, 0.5 or 1.0 (0.5 = natural).
v3 varies a little between generations of the same text, which is why every sentence file is generated once and then reused.
stability 1.0 (robust) chosen on 18 Sep 2026: at 0.5 the voice glued 'cho anh' into 'choang'. 1.0 separates the syllables. v3 accepts 0.0, 0.5 or 1.0 only.

The Saigon respelling (d and gi -> y at the start of a syllable) lives in scripts/common.py, function saigon_respell, and runs on every sentence automatically. The tts column in sentences.csv overrides it for single sentences. r stays wrong in every voice and is flagged in the notes instead.
